About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.




So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.





About the role

This role sits at the center of Vasion’s next chapter of growth. The Senior Growth Marketing Manager will scale Vasion’s ABM strategy across our priority verticals from campaign activation through pipeline generation, turning target account engagement into the revenue that fuels company growth. This is a senior role for a marketer with hands-on ABM experience, strong data and analytical skills, and a track record of turning strategy into pipeline results, serving as a strategic partner to Sales and partnering closely with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Paid Media, and internal teams to keep investment aligned to shared goals.

What you'll do

Campaign Activation & ABM Strategy

Lead ABM strategy and activation across priority verticals, partnering with Sales on account prioritization and targeting.
Build and run vertical-specific campaigns grounded in deep persona and segment knowledge.
Own the campaign calendar and brief creation process for assigned verticals, sequencing programs to meet pipeline needs throughout the year.
Stay ahead of shifts in ABM technology, targeting capabilities, and the broader digital marketing landscape, and apply what’s relevant to keep Vasion’s campaigns and tech stack current.

Data & Performance

Build campaign performance views and dashboards connecting activity to account engagement, pipeline, and revenue; use data and intent signals to continuously inform and optimize.
Analyze business, pipeline, and paid media performance, including seasonality and vertical-specific trends, to shape campaign strategy.
Bring pipeline and performance trends into quarterly planning to guide where budget and campaigns shift next.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Paid Media teams to align investment with revenue priorities and track results.
Be the senior subject matter expert on ABM and sales practices, mentoring teammates and shaping how the Growth Marketing team runs campaigns.

Communication & Executive Presence

Turn campaign data into insights and recommendations that give Marketing and Sales leadership visibility into what is influencing our pipeline.
Build and present strategic points of view and frameworks; comfortable presenting directly to senior leadership.
Qualifications

Campaign Activation & ABM Experience

7+ years in B2B or SaaS demand generation or growth marketing, with hands-on ABM campaign activation, including audience segmentation, target account lists, personas, and ABM technologies.
A track record of running vertical marketing campaigns, building rapport with Sales organizations, with direct experience on multi-channel campaigns including email, paid media, and CPL programs.

Data Fluency

Skilled at analyzing business, pipeline, and paid media performance metrics, including seasonality and vertical-specific trends.
A track record of using data and insights to improve campaign performance.

Cross-Functional & Sales Leadership

Demonstrated ability to work closely with Sales and turn Sales priorities into marketing action.
Sharp cross-functional instincts, with experience partnering across Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Design, Content, and Sales to move projects forward.
Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously without dropped handoffs.

Communication & Presentation

Confident communicator and presenter, with the ability to build strategic POVs and frameworks and present to senior leadership.
A track record of researching, evaluating Martech platforms, ABM tools or frameworks, or industry trends and turning that knowledge into recommendations the team can act on.
Benefits
Flexible work environment
Vacation Bonus
Flexible paid time off
Paid parental leave
Competitive pay
A full suite of traditional benefits
Training/Advancement opportunities
401k with company match and immediate vesting
Financial wellness education
Company-contributed HSA
On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.




Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.




More about Vasion

Visit https://www.vasion.com to learn more about Vasion.




Additional Information

Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.

Leland is building the home for ambition in the age of AI. We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. We help businesses become AI-native through training, hiring, and infrastructure. Since our founding in 2021, we've helped tens of thousands of people reach their most ambitious goals and raised $19M from world-class investors. Ambition is sacred to us, and we've built a product that takes that seriously.

About the Role

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn. You'll run and scale the paid engine behind our consumer business, where people come to Leland to get into school, land the job, or build real skills with AI. You'll also help us build paid for B2B from close to the ground up, starting with the AI Builder Program for teams and companies and eventually extending to our university partners and other AI offerings that growing at Leland. You'll be in the accounts every day, and you'll use Claude and other AI tools to run more channels and more tests than one person normally could. If you've scaled paid budgets profitably and want real ownership over a channel that directly drives revenue, we'd love to chat with you!

What You'll Do
Own paid acquisition for our consumer business

Run Google (Search, PMax, YouTube), Meta, and LinkedIn day to day, including budgets, bidding, targeting, creative rotation, and reporting

Manage spend across our core consumer categories and develop a clear point of view on where the next dollar should go

Hit CAC and payback targets, and flag early and honestly when something isn't working, and also help us refine which metrics are most important to track at various points of the funnel

Run a steady stream of structured tests across audiences, offers, landing pages, and creative, and document what you learn so the team gets smarter over time

Partner daily with channel and business unit owners so paid supports the full buyer journey, from first touch to purchase or closed deal

Build paid for B2B

Continue to develop the early stage of our B2B paid motion, starting with Google and LinkedIn and Meta, to generate pipeline for the AI Builder Program's team and enterprise offering

Partner with sales and AI Programs marketing on ICP, target account lists, lead magnets, and the handoff from lead to booked meeting

Refine how paid can support our university business as it grows

Build reporting that ties spend to pipeline and closed revenue, not just form fills, signups or clicks

Make the channel AI-native

Use Claude and other tools to automate repetitive portions of the job: pulling reports, catching anomalies, drafting ad variations, building audiences, and QA'ing campaigns

Get the most out of each platform's built-in automation and AI capabilities while knowing when to take the wheel back

Build systems and documentation so the channel doesn't live only in your head but has shared context across marketing, with insights disseminating to Leland broadly

Work closely with our content and creative team (or contractors) to keep a healthy pipeline of ad creative, and give them clear, specific feedback on what's performing

About You

5–7 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with direct ownership of meaningful budgets on Google, Meta, and LinkedIn

Experience on both sides is a plus: you've driven consumer purchases and you've built pipeline for a sales-led B2B product

Strong with data and comfortable in the ad platforms, GA4, with experience in Databricks as a plus. You understand attribution, lift testing and have opinions and experience on pitfalls to avoid

Already using AI in your daily workflow and have built real things with it, like automations, scripts, skills, or agents; you'd rather automate your own busywork than do it by hand

A systems thinker who builds processes that hold up as spend and channel count grow

Direct communicator who gives an honest read on performance, good or bad

Bonus: experience in edtech, marketplaces, AI enablement or selling to L&D or university buyers

Leland is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and demographics to apply.

Why Leland?

The chance to join a world-class team helping people achieve their career and educational dreams

Work in a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions have a direct impact

Operate in a fast-paced, AI-native environment

We don't hire people who merely want to work for a great company; we hire people who want to make a great company

OPPORTUNITY DETAILS
About this role.

About Us
Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We’re backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other’s growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Risk Advisory to join our Product Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Director of Product Marketing. This role is the connective tissue between Product and our go to market teams (sales, customer success, and marketing), translating our product roadmap and release cadence into positioning, messaging, and enablement that reaches the right internal and external audience at the right time.

You’ll need to be comfortable operating in an environment where features ship often and clear communication matters. Success here means proactively keeping GTM teams aligned with that pace, while showing a high degree of autonomy and ownership.

Understanding the risk advisory landscape and how advisory firms operate is a key part of this role. Candidates with hands-on risk advisory experience (internal audit, SOC, compliance, or similar) are encouraged to apply, even without a traditional product marketing background.

What You’ll Do:

Product Positioning, Messaging & GTM:

Develop clear and compelling product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that differentiates the product from competitors.

Create and maintain buyer personas to better understand target audiences.

Plan and execute go-to-market strategies for product launches.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, marketing, sales, and customer success

Go-To-Market Enablement:

Develop sales tools and collateral (including, presentations, product demos, white papers, datasheets) to support the sales team

Train sales teams on product features, benefits, and how to effectively sell the product

Equip customer success with the messaging and resources they need to drive adoption, retention, and expansion conversations

Partner with solutions engineers on positioning and demo narratives that support technical evaluations

Customer Advisory Board & Content Creation:

Own the Advisory Customer Advisory Board (CAB) program in collaboration with Revenue Marketing, ensuring planning, programming and execution are on-time, on-budget and provide an elevated experience for all stakeholders

Partner with Revenue Marketing and Product to identify and build additional in-market strategies

Own the VP of Product blog and internal product newsletter

Develop webinar content, case studies, testimonials, and other customer proof content in partnership with GTM teams

About You:

10+ years of product or content marketing experience at advisory or adjacent SaaS organizations, or equivalent risk advisory experience with a fast ramp into marketing

Strong writer across blogs, newsletters, case studies, and webinars

Comfortable in a fast moving environment with an evolving roadmap

A self starter who owns workstreams end to end, communicating status and surfacing blockers proactively

Strong project management skills, able to prioritize across concurrent workstreams

Adaptable across tools and systems, with the judgment to find efficiencies and use AI effectively

More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

Fearless – Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

Fast – Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

Lovable – ​​Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

Owners – Execute & run the business with ownership.

Win-win – Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

Inclusive – Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

About the Role

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role at the center of how NetBox Labs drives pipeline. As our Senior Demand Generation Manager, you’ll be responsible for the strategy and execution behind how we create and accelerate demand — from integrated campaign development and account-based marketing to email nurture, social, and our website. If you’re energized by proactivity and making a real impact — and want to do it at a company with a product that practitioners genuinely love and executives choose for their critical infrastructure — this is your seat.

About this role.

Veriff is the trust infrastructure platform for the world’s most innovative companies, and we need the market to understand exactly why that matters and why it matters with us rather than anyone else. The Head of Product Marketing will own that answer.

This is a build-and-elevate role. You will bring structure, clarity, and commercial impact to a function that is critical to Veriff’s next stage of growth.

Reporting to the CMO, you will lead a lean PMM team and operate as a true partner to Sales and Product. You will turn Veriff’s technical differentiation into clear, compelling stories that win deals, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen our position in the market.

Stay ahead of category shifts across identity, fraud, and trust infrastructure

Ensure vertical strategies are activated consistently across campaigns, content, and sales motions

Partner with Product to ensure commercial readiness including packaging, pricing input, and sales readiness

OPPORTUNITY DETAILS
About this role.

About the Team

An instrumental part of GOAT Group, the Marketing team oversees a wide range of activities, which aim to build awareness, consideration and loyalty for our brands. As a member of this team, you will work to execute thoughtful, data-driven marketing campaigns that drive meaningful growth for the company.

Role Overview

GOAT Group is seeking a Sr. Performance Marketing Specialist to run our paid social and video acquisition strategy. You will own and operate Meta, TikTok, and YouTube Ads. You will also develop the creative testing roadmap and leverage incrementality to measure performance. This role reports to the AVP of Growth.

We expect AI fluency in practice. As targeting, bidding, and placement have moved inside the platforms’ models, creative has become the main lever you control. Leveraging AI tools for strategic research and automating operations will be key to success. Much of our process is being automated through internal AI workflows, so this role will have more emphasis on workflow oversight.

In this role, you will:

Run day-to-day paid social and video across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube: campaign build, budget pacing, audience and placement setup, and optimization against incrementality KPIs.
Plan and execute the creative testing roadmap — write briefs, launch tests, experiment readouts.
Leverage AI tools (Claude, Gemini, internal workflows) for strategic research and operations. You’ll partner closely with the AVP of Growth to continually develop and improve AI workflows.
Build and maintain the weekly and monthly creative performance marketing reports.
Partner with Brand and Creative on asset needs, turning performance reads into specific, useful creative direction.
Run structured tests — holdouts, geo splits, incrementality reads — supporting the AVP of Growth, and interpret the results honestly against platform-reported numbers.
Flag new formats, placements, and platform features worth testing, and make the case for trying them.

How Success Is Measured

Incrementality. To truly understand the performance of our efforts, we rely on incrementality methods, such as geolift. We then leverage platform metrics as multipliers based on the measurement outcomes for daily operational KPIs.
Creative performance. Leverage platform metrics to build creative narratives to explain how they performed and what we should do next.
Operational reliability. Campaigns should launch accurately and on time. With AI automated more operations, this person must be have final oversight before campaigns launch.

We are looking for:

3+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and/or YouTube Ads.
Experience with incrementality and/or MMM to measure true lift or causal performance.
Comfort working in performance data — pivot tables, dashboards, and enough rigor to catch a number that looks wrong before it reaches a deck.
AI fluency in practice. You use LLMs and AI tooling in your daily workflow for briefs, copy variants, creative iteration, and reporting, and you can tell us specifically what it changed about your output and what you had to watch for.
Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a result, including a disappointing one, to people who do not live in the ad platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in a marketplace, resale, ecommerce, or DTC business.
Familiarity with creative automation tooling such as Motion, Pencil, Smartly, or AdCreative.
SQL, or experience pulling your own data from a warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery.
Exposure to affiliate networks, creator-commerce platforms, or TikTok Shop.
Mobile app install campaign experience, including MMPs such as AppsFlyer or Branch.
Interest in or knowledge of sneakers, streetwear, and resale marketplaces.

GOAT Group represents the leading platforms for authentic sneakers, apparel and accessories. Operating four distinct brands–GOAT, Flight Club, Grailed and alias–GOAT Group has a global community of more than 60 million members across 170 countries.

GOAT is the global platform for the greatest products from the past, present and future. Since its founding in 2015, GOAT has become one of the leading and most trusted sneaker platforms in the world, and has expanded to offer apparel and accessories from select emerging, contemporary and iconic brands. Through its unique positioning between the primary and resale markets, the company offers styles across various time periods on its digital platforms and in its retail locations, while delivering products to over 60 million members across 170 countries.

Established in New York City over 15 years ago, Flight Club revolutionized sneaker retail as the original consignment store for rare shoes. Carrying the rarest exclusives and collectible sneakers, Flight Club has evolved from a one-stop sneaker destination, to a cultural hub for sneaker enthusiasts and novices alike. With three brick-and-mortar locations in New York City, Los Angeles and Miami, Flight Club remains the premier source for authentic, rare sneakers.

Founded in 2013, Grailed is the leading community-driven marketplace for rare luxury, streetwear and vintage fashion. The marketplace was built for enthusiasts, by enthusiasts, and features products from brands including Supreme, Raf Simons, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Prada and more. With a highly curated selection of resale pieces including inventory exclusive to the platform, Grailed makes fashion accessible.

The company is backed by strategic investor Foot Locker, Inc. as well as some of the leading names in venture capital including Park West Asset Management, T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., Franklin Templeton, Adage Capital Management, Ulysses Management, D1 Capital Partners, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, Index Ventures, Matrix Partners, Upfront Ventures, Webb Investment Network and Y Combinator.

OPPORTUNITY DETAILS
About this role.

Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we’re a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the SEO and AI visibility solutions we build for our clients: more than 20,000 real estate websites that rank independently, each in its own market, with its own authority, its own competitors, and a real business depending on the outcome. This is not the SEO of a single corporate domain or one large marketplace. It is a platform product, where one change to a template, a schema implementation, or the way we render content moves thousands of domains at once.

The mandate is an excellent organic discovery platform: technical foundations, page experience, conversion, content, measurement, migrations, and experimentation. AI search is a growing part of that. Our clients are evaluated by Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode, by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and by every prospective seller who asks an assistant which agent they should call. The best people in this job design for three constituencies at once: the people who visit these sites, the crawlers and AI agents that read them, and the real estate business whose revenue depends on both.

This is not a job for someone who runs audits and hands recommendations to other people. You will set the strategy, ship with your own engineering team, and build the defaults, standards, and safeguards that make quality hold across the entire fleet. Most real estate professionals will never hire a technical SEO of their own. Our platform is how they get one.

What You’ll Do
Own the product strategy and roadmap for organic discovery and AI visibility across every site on the platform, including what clients can see, control, and get credit for
Own the technical foundations across every page type we generate: crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, structured data, and page performance
Productize what repeats. When the same issue or workflow shows up across the fleet, solve it once through better defaults, automation, shared capabilities, or safeguards
Make our clients’ brands, listings, and expertise legible to AI assistants, and define how we measure citations and visibility across answer engines
Run a real experimentation program: prove changes on representative cohorts of sites, establish incremental impact, then scale what works rather than shipping broadly and inferring impact afterward
Own migration quality and regression prevention, including the standards, acceptance criteria, and automated checks that hold search quality as the platform ships
Partner with the team building the next generation of our website platform so search is designed in from the start, and give every product team a low-friction path to the right implementation
Set platform-level goals for organic performance, AI visibility, and client outcomes, and report against them to leadership
Who You Are
8+ years combined across SEO and product management, including 3+ years as a product manager shipping alongside engineering teams
You have owned search for a platform that hosts many independent customer domains, such as a website builder, a hosting or commerce platform, or a multi-location or franchise network. Running search for one large marketplace or corporate domain is valuable experience, but the fleet problem is a different job and it is the one we have
Deep technical foundation across rendering and JavaScript SEO, crawl and index management, information architecture, structured data, page performance, and migrations
You treat bots and AI agents as users of a website alongside people, and you design for both without trading one against the other
Obsessive about experimentation and measurement, including cohort testing, causal impact analysis, Search Console data at scale, log analysis, and the discipline to tell a result from a coincidence
A current point of view on AI search, including how models discover, interpret, and cite a brand, and the judgment to separate what genuinely moves visibility from what is repackaged advice
Fluent with AI as a working tool. You use it to investigate messy systems, establish ground truth quickly, prototype solutions, and unblock yourself rather than waiting on another team at every stage of discovery
You get requirements implemented by teams you do not own, and you are welcome back afterward. What you write is sharp enough that a team of engineers can move without waiting on you
Opinionated about prioritization. This space generates infinite work, and your judgment about what to ignore matters as much as what you ship
Preferred Qualifications
Experience at a website platform such as Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, WordPress, or Duda
Experience with programmatic or template-driven SEO across large page inventories
Local and entity-driven search experience, since our clients compete market by market
Conversion and page experience work alongside acquisition, since traffic that does not convert does not help a client
Background in PropTech, real estate, or another B2B2C category where the platform’s job is to make its customers win
Experience building client-facing reporting or diagnostic tools for a non-technical audience

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We’re a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We’re backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry’s most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn’s Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we’ve received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll drive profitable acquisition of paid subscribers and work on related projects that aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information.

Supporting strategy and planning for new paid advertising initiatives to profitably scale subscriptions

Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging following a brand refresh

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable paid subscriber growth. This role will help create and execute a new marketing program for paid subscriptions. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, creative testing, and by optimizing paid subscriber conversion. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

About Chili Piper

We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!

About the role

At Chili Piper, community and events are at the heart of our GTM strategy. From intimate dinners to large-scale activations like our annual ChiliPalooza, we bring top GTM leaders together to connect, exchange ideas, and build lasting relationships. It’s how we turn a room full of people into real pipeline, and how we’ve built a community that actually wants to hear from us.

We’re hiring an Events Manager to scale these experiences and deepen our relationships with the GTM community: executive dinners, industry conferences, sponsorships, speaking moments, webinars, and ChiliPalooza. This is the person who turns our presence in a room, physical or virtual, into brand awareness, pipeline, and lasting relationships.

This role is part of our marketing team and works cross-functionally with Sales and Partnerships to run Chili Piper’s global event strategy. You’ll have real ownership of the calendar and where we show up, not just the execution. You’ll shape the annual plan, then make it happen: logistics, promotion, on-site, and follow-up, all the way through to measurable impact.

This is a hands-on role. You’re the one building the landing pages, pulling the CRM lists, and running the show on-site, not handing a brief to an agency and waiting. It’s a strong fit for someone who is organized and proactive, thinks creatively about how we show up, and brings original ideas and a sense of humor to every event. It’s fully remote, with travel to events as needed.

Own the annual event calendar. Decide, with marketing leadership, where Chili Piper should have a presence and why, and protect that focus as new opportunities come up

Bring original ideas, creativity, and humor to how we show up, so our events feel like Chili Piper and not like everyone else’s

Manage execution end to end. Logistics, budgets, venues, vendors, shipments, swag, and on-site coordination, done by you and tracked by you

Run event promotion from start to finish. Build event and webinar landing pages, export and segment contact lists from Salesforce and HubSpot to target the right attendees by city or segment, and send invites, reminders, and follow-ups independently

Produce our virtual events and webinars end to end, from speaker prep and rehearsal to running the live show

Collaborate across teams. With Marketing on branding, design, and promotion; with Sales to identify and invite the right prospects and customers; with Partnerships to coordinate sponsors and activations

Ensure smooth on-site execution. Keep schedules on track and deliver a seamless experience from load-in to last handshake

Build and nurture community. Deepen our relationships with GTM leaders, partners, and community members so our events compound over time

Track performance. Collect attendee data, measure engagement, and report on outcomes and pipeline impact

Amplify results. Work with Marketing to repurpose event content, including photos, videos, and testimonials, for social and post-event communication

Manage vendors and budgets. Source partners, negotiate rates, and keep quality high and costs in check

Run the debrief on every event and turn what you learn into a stronger program next time

Builder mindset. You don’t wait for someone to tell you how, you figure it out

Tech-savvy operator. You know your way around CRM exports, spreadsheets, event tools, and email automation

Hands-on doer. You do the execution and track the results yourself

Creative problem-solver. When a venue cancels or a vendor flakes, you find a workaround fast, and when the format is stale, you invent a better one

Organized and proactive. You turn chaos into systems and think two steps ahead

Customer-first. You care about memorable, frictionless experiences from invite to post-event follow-up

Curious and eager to learn. You’re always exploring new tools, trends, and ideas, including AI, to make each event better than the last

Experience

2+ years in event management, field marketing, or community roles, ideally in B2B SaaS

Proven ability to plan and execute events, from small dinners to large activations

Hands-on experience with CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot, and event platforms like Luma, Zoom Webinars or similar

Strong cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships

Experience managing partner collaborations or maintaining relationships with GTM leaders and communities is a plus

Nice to have

Experience in B2B SaaS, RevOps, or MarTech

Prior involvement in partner activations or co-marketing events

Experience managing sponsorships or collaborations with other brands

Comfortable using analytics tools to measure event outcomes

A strong network within the GTM, Sales, or Marketing communities

Background in social or content amplification around events, for example capturing and repurposing event moments

Interview process

Application review. We’ll review your background and experience to make sure there’s a good fit for the role.

Culture add interview. A first chat to get to know you: what drives you, how you like to work, and what unique perspective you’d bring to Chili Piper.

Assessment. A short, practical assignment to see how you think and approach a real events challenge. It’s not a test, we just want to see your creativity and thought process.

Executive interview. The final step. We’ll talk about your bigger picture, your passion for the space, your understanding of our product, and why Chili Piper feels like the right next step for you.

TL;DR

We’re not hiring a “planner.” We’re hiring someone who can own the full experience, from the CRM export to the on-site execution to the community that keeps growing after everyone goes home, and turn GTM moments into momentum and measurable results.

If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

Additional Information

Why you’ll love being a part of our team:

Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future.

Work with an immensely talented global team

Work in a business that’s run fairly and transparently

Competitive pay based on market rate wherever you live

We lead by example–showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow–while having fun

How we work:

Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we’ve been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.

Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. We come up with new angles on existing problems or invent better solutions to help companies with their sales and marketing. Then we turn these ideas into beautiful, smart software.

Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

Be helpful. Our first value as a company is help. Help our customers be successful. Help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our products. Help our team members reach their full potential.

The perks:

Generous health, dental, and vision insurance

Any equipment/software/tech that you need to do your job

Annual professional development stipend of $2,000 USD

Equity – all Pipers receive stock options

Annual company retreat in epic locations (past trips: Paris, Morocco, Tulum, Iceland, Ibiza, India). Check out the video from last year’s retreat in Tenerife.

About this role.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

Location: Remote, EMEA and Americas 

What your day will look like
Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data-driven insights.
Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.
What we are looking for in you
Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
Data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
Comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution, a true self-starter.
Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.
What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Fully remote working environment – we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Salt Lake City, UtahMarketing – Marketing /Full-Time /On-Site

Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
 
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.


Role Summary:

The Vice President, Performance Marketing owns the end-to-end strategy, execution, and scaling of performance-driven lead generation across SEO/AEO/GEO, SEM, email, affiliate, and emerging channels. This executive leader will architect a high-velocity demand funnel that fuels MQL → SQL → SAL → revenue targets across all product lines and industries.  

Reporting directly to the CGO, the VP will build and lead a world-class performance marketing organization, establish predictive forecasting models, and implement real-time optimization frameworks powered by data, automation, and cross-functional alignment.

Responsibilities

Strategic Ownership: Design and execute a unified performance marketing strategy that drives predictable, scalable demand across B2B and B2C segments.  

Funnel Architecture: Build and optimize a multi-touch attribution funnel with stage-specific KPIs (MQL, SQL, SAL, pipeline velocity, revenue attribution).  

Target Setting & Accountability: Define, forecast, and hit aggressive growth targets for lead volume, cost-per-lead, conversion rates, and downstream revenue impact.  

Data & Analytics Leadership: Establish enterprise-grade reporting, dashboards, and experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, incrementality, LTV:CAC modeling).  

Team Building & Leadership: Scale and mentor a high-performing team; recruit senior talent in paid social, SEO, and lifecycle marketing.  

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Finance to align marketing investment with revenue outcomes and unit economics.  

Innovation & Channel Expansion: Identify and pilot high-ROI channels (e.g., TikTok, Reddit, partner co-marketing, review platforms) while optimizing core engines (Google, LinkedIn, Meta). 

Qualifications:

10+ years of progressive experience in performance marketing, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or above) at a high-growth SaaS, tech, or AI-native company.  

Proven P&L Impact: Track record of building and scaling $10M+ performance marketing budgets with measurable ROI and revenue attribution.  

Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO platforms (SEMrush, Ahrefs), Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, CDP integration, and HTML/CSS for landing page optimization.  

Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in performance forecasting, cohort analysis, attribution modeling, and statistical significance testing.  

Leadership & Team Scaling: Experience hiring, developing, and leading distributed or multi-disciplinary marketing teams (8+ members).  

Creative Problem-Solving: Known for testing bold hypotheses, failing fast, and iterating toward breakthrough efficiency.  

Collaborative Operator: Thrives in high-autonomy environments; partners seamlessly with Sales, Product, and Executive leadership.  

Nice-to-Have

Led demand gen at a company with $50M+ ARR** or 1M+ monthly active users.  

Built in-house capabilities in SEO content engines, email lifecycle automation and affiliate/partnership programs.  

Experience with Capterra, G2, Software Advice, or industry-specific review platforms.  

Familiarity with privacy-first marketing.  

Work Location Expectation: Filevine maintains offices in Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Chicago, and New York. Candidates based in or near these metropolitan areas will work on a hybrid or in-office schedule, while candidates located outside these regions are eligible for remote work

- A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive 
- Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (for full-time employees)
- Competitive & Fair Pay
- Maternity & paternity leave (for full-time employees)
- Short & long-term disability
- Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team
- Top-of-the-line company swag

Your role in our mission
 
Prosper is seeking an analytically-driven, values-led VP of Marketing to accelerate our mission of advancing financial well-being. As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will oversee the end-to-end marketing ecosystem - from performance-based acquisition to the launch of new borrowing and investing products. We need a leader who can mentor a talented team of 20+ while maintaining a sharp focus on ROI and market-leading brand positioning. Whether you work from our San Francisco headquarters or remotely in the US, you will be the lead storyteller and strategist connecting our products to the millions who need them.
How you’ll make an impact
Drive scalable growth: You will own top-of-funnel metrics and multi-year marketing plans for our retail investor, personal loan, and credit card portfolios. You’ll determine requirements, assess support needs, build internal alignment, and deliver results that hit our aggressive volume targets. You will accelerate the development of enhanced machine learning targeting models and aggressive customer research. 
Define the competitive edge: You will lead us to beat the competition at our game - not theirs. This means overseeing deep market research and competitor analysis to drive recommendations that lean into Prosper’s unique marketplace advantages. You will lead a proactive PR strategy to ensure our strengths are clearly communicated and widely recognized by the market, media, and our customers.
Influence the product roadmap: You will act as a key partner on new product design, bringing deep market intelligence and customer insights to the table to ensure our future offerings are positioned to win from day one.
Level-up the team: You’ll mentor and empower our 20+-person team to be a data-first execution engine that thrives on mission-driven, high-performance culture.
Who you’ll build with
Reporting to the CEO, you will work in close alignment with the President & CFO, CTO, and General Counsel to position marketing as a primary driver of Prosper’s financial and technical roadmap.
You will collaborate daily with the Heads of Product, Credit, and Operations to deliver a seamless borrower and investor experience.
You will lead the entire marketing organization, providing strategic oversight to your direct reports: the Sr. Director of Performance Marketing & Analytics, the Director of Web & Conversion, and the Sr. Partnerships Manager.
Skills that will help you thrive
Fintech Leadership: 15+ years of marketing experience with a deep mastery of the personal loan and financial services landscape, including content, digital and product marketing. 
The ROI mindset: A proven track record of driving ROI-positive acquisition across multiple channels, including digital, direct mail, and lead aggregators.
Data as a second language: Strong analytical rigor with the ability to use performance data to pivot strategies and uncover untapped market segments.
Executive presence: High-level communication skills with a history of presenting performance and vision to employees and the Board of Directors.
Regulatory fluency: A firm grasp of compliance and regulatory standards for advertising and acquisition in financial markets.
Academic foundation: A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Resources to help you prosper
A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.

Marketing sourced and marketing influenced bookings growth against target

Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

People looking for small gigs

Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. Oct 08, 2026 - Credit Wellness, LLC is hiring a remote Inside Sales Contractor. 💸 Salary: OTE $25k - $35k. 📍Location: Worldwide.

About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).



Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.



Week 0: Unpaid

Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

Home office or a quiet place to work.

Strong internet connection.

Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)
